exposure: Type of anesthetic agent (bupivacaine vs. levobupivacaine)
outcome: Time to reach maximum height of sensory block
cohort: 120 pregnant females classified as Grade-II according to the American Society of Anesthesiologists, scheduled for Cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Levobupivacaine resulted in faster onset of sensory block but slower onset of motor block compared to bupivacaine, and also led to shorter duration of sensory and motor block.
